fact: Statistics Mauritius released its ICT statistics report on 10 July 2026 with 2024 results of the Continuous Multi-Purpose Household Survey, such as 83.2% of persons aged 12 and above using the internet and 85.8% of households with internet access.

Statistics Mauritius released online on 30 June 2026 its first-quarter 2026 labour force estimates from the Continuous Multi-Purpose Household Survey (CMPHS), a national household survey covering all private households in Mauritius and Rodrigues, run monthly since 2005 with about 11,280 households sampled a year.

The document says the 2022 Housing and Population Census results were used to review sampling strata from 2023 and to revise the population figures behind the labour force estimates; no enumeration date is given, so the year is used.

Statistics Mauritius released online on 19 May 2026 its 2025 annual labour force, employment and unemployment estimates from the Continuous Multi-Purpose Household Survey (about 11,280 households a year), covering Mauritius and Rodrigues.

Statistics Mauritius says its labour force estimates from 2025 use population figures revised to the results of the 2022 population census; the document gives no enumeration day, so 2022 is the year of the census.
